objective: Test the qutrit-qubit finite record mechanism independently of any photon-coupling identification.

requiredOperations: qubit generalized X and Z Weyl gates
qutrit generalized X and Z Weyl gates
classically sampled correlated local Weyl conjugations

gates.name: protocol integrity
gates.criterion: exact carrier, distribution and POVM arithmetic pass

gates.name: unread sampler and channel
gates.criterion: total variation <= 0.02; local eigenvalues <= 0.02; connected gain within 0.02 of eta

gates.name: phase-complete port
gates.criterion: uncubed qubit and qutrit quadratures agree with calibrated central phases within 0.03

gates.name: cubed binary port
gates.criterion: qutrit X > 0.9, qubit X < -0.9, phase closure residual < 0.06 radians

gates.name: centrality
gates.criterion: cubed qutrit X spread over six input preparations <= 0.06

gates.name: record POVM
gates.criterion: binary-character likelihood wins and differs from the nearest no-commutator hypothesis by >= 5 standard errors

controls: retain uncubed X/Y phase port while testing the cubed port
reverse operation order and require conjugate uncubed phase
seal but retain the unread-channel random-label log
repeat cubed readout over a spanning set of system preparations
sweep control frequency in both directions to expose lag and hysteresis
report raw counts, calibration parameters and every failed gate

interpretationBoundary.passShows: the finite unread-channel, cubed-character and record-POVM mechanism survives one calibrated end-to-end protocol
interpretationBoundary.passDoesNotShow: that the finite invariant is the fine-structure constant or a photon pole residue
interpretationBoundary.photonPromotionRequires: an independently normalized conserved current, massless transverse pole and residue matching without alpha as calibration input
